text: 锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土
pinyin: chú hé rì dāng wǔ, hàn dī hé xià tǔ
literal: hoe · grain · sun · at · noon · sweat · drips · grain · below · soil
natural: hoeing at noon, sweat drips into the soil

meaning.en: The hard toil of farmers; a reminder to value food.
meaning.zh: 农民在烈日下辛苦劳作，提醒人们珍惜粮食。

examples.zh: “锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土”，农民种地太不容易了。
examples.en: 'Hoeing at noon, sweat drips to the soil' — farming is so hard.

examples.zh: 看到烈日下干活的农民，我想起了“锄禾日当午”。
examples.en: Seeing farmers working in the blazing sun, I thought of 'hoeing at noon'.

examples.zh: 孩子们背诵锄禾日当午，学会了节约粮食。
examples.en: Reciting 'hoeing at noon', the children learned not to waste food.

story.en: Li Shen's poem 'Pity the Peasants': 'Hoeing grain at noon, sweat drips to the soil below. Who knows that of the meal on the plate, every grain is bitter toil?'
story.zh: 李绅《悯农》：“锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土。谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦。”

usage.en: The first two lines of 《悯农》; the last two are 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦.
usage.zh: 《悯农》前两句，后两句是“谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦”。

synonyms: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦

meaning.en: Tall buildings; a modern city skyline.

examples.zh: 城市里高楼大厦越来越多。
examples.en: There are more and more high-rises in the city.

examples.zh: 昔日的农田变成了高楼大厦。
examples.en: Former farmland has become tower blocks.

examples.zh: 高楼大厦平地起，靠的是坚实的地基。
examples.en: Tall buildings rise from the ground on solid foundations.

usage.en: Often in descriptions of urban change.
usage.zh: 多用于描写城市变化。

meaning.en: Rising tall and abrupt from the ground (buildings, peaks).
meaning.zh: 形容建筑物、山峰等突兀地高高耸立。

examples.zh: 一座座新楼拔地而起。
examples.en: New buildings are springing up one after another.

examples.zh: 桂林的山峰拔地而起，形态各异。
examples.en: Guilin's peaks rise sheer from the ground in every shape.

examples.zh: 几年时间，一座新城拔地而起。
examples.en: In a few years a whole new city rose from the ground.

usage.en: Common in news about construction and in landscape writing.
usage.zh: 多见于建设报道、风景描写。

meaning.en: To set up rules and institutional systems.

examples.zh: 公司成立之初就注重建章立制。
examples.en: From its founding the company focused on putting rules in place.

examples.zh: 要通过建章立制，堵住管理漏洞。
examples.en: Loopholes must be closed by establishing proper rules and systems.

usage.en: Official and management jargon.
usage.zh: 官方、管理用语。

meaning.en: Crafted with meticulous care.
meaning.zh: 精心细致地雕刻琢磨，形容做事认真细致。

examples.zh: 这件玉器经过精雕细琢，十分精美。
examples.en: The jade piece was meticulously carved and is exquisite.

examples.zh: 他对每一句台词都精雕细琢。
examples.en: He polishes every line of dialogue to perfection.

examples.zh: 好文章需要精雕细琢。
examples.en: Good writing needs careful polishing.

usage.en: Literal (carving) and figurative (writing, design).
usage.zh: 可指雕刻，也比喻写作、设计。琢读zhuó。

meaning.en: Badly run-down and dilapidated.

examples.zh: 老宅已经破败不堪。
examples.en: The old house is falling apart.

examples.zh: 战后的城市破败不堪。
examples.en: After the war the city was in ruins.

usage.en: For buildings, towns, also institutions.
usage.zh: 多指建筑、城镇，也可指机构。

meaning.en: Leaning so much it looks about to fall.

examples.zh: 那根电线杆倾斜欲倒，十分危险。
examples.en: The utility pole is leaning precariously and very dangerous.

examples.zh: 台风过后，许多树木倾斜欲倒。
examples.en: After the typhoon, many trees were leaning, about to fall.

usage.en: Descriptive; the set phrase is 摇摇欲坠.
usage.zh: 描写性说法，常用“摇摇欲坠”。

meaning.en: Shoddily built construction, usually due to corruption.

examples.zh: 这座桥刚建好就出现裂缝，简直是豆腐渣工程。
examples.en: The bridge cracked just after completion — total jerry-building.

examples.zh: 要严查豆腐渣工程背后的腐败。
examples.en: The corruption behind shoddy construction must be investigated.

examples.zh: 这批校舍决不能成为豆腐渣工程。
examples.en: These school buildings must never be shoddy work.

usage.en: Coined by Premier Zhu Rongji in 1998 after the Jiujiang flood-dyke collapse.
usage.zh: 1998年九江大堤决口后由朱镕基总理提出，广为流传。

meaning.en: Democratic centralism: discussion first, then unified decision.
meaning.zh: 民主基础上的集中和集中指导下的民主相结合。

examples.zh: 会议坚持民主集中的原则，先充分讨论再作决定。
examples.en: The meeting followed democratic centralism: full discussion, then a decision.

examples.zh: 民主集中制是党的根本组织原则。
examples.en: Democratic centralism is the Party's basic organisational principle.

usage.en: Political term, usually 民主集中制.
usage.zh: 政治术语，多说“民主集中制”。

natural: diligent and caring for the people

meaning.en: Governing diligently and caring for the people.

examples.zh: 这位县长勤政爱民，深受百姓爱戴。
examples.en: The county head governed diligently and was loved by the people.

examples.zh: 古代勤政爱民的清官被后人传颂。
examples.en: Upright ancient officials who served the people are still praised today.

usage.en: Praise for officials.
usage.zh: 称赞官员。

meaning.en: Clean, upright and incorruptible in office.

examples.zh: 他为官清正廉洁，从不收礼。
examples.en: As an official he was incorruptible and never accepted gifts.

examples.zh: 干部要清正廉洁，做群众的表率。
examples.en: Officials must be clean and upright, an example to the public.

usage.en: Official praise.
usage.zh: 官方褒扬用语。

meaning.en: Embezzlement and corruption.

examples.zh: 政府严厉打击贪污腐败。
examples.en: The government is cracking down hard on corruption.

examples.zh: 贪污腐败严重损害了百姓的利益。
examples.en: Graft has seriously harmed the people's interests.

usage.en: Standard term in news and policy.
usage.zh: 新闻、政策常用。

meaning.en: Government orders fail to be carried out.
meaning.zh: 政府的命令得不到贯彻执行。

examples.zh: 地方保护主义导致政令不通。
examples.en: Local protectionism means central orders aren't carried out.

examples.zh: 政令不通，改革就无法推进。
examples.en: If orders don't get through, reform can't move forward.

usage.en: Opposite of 令行禁止 / 政令畅通.
usage.zh: 反义说法“令行禁止”“政令畅通”。

meaning.en: Supported and honoured by the whole populace.
meaning.zh: 受到广大百姓的拥护和爱戴。

examples.zh: 这位开国皇帝深得万民拥戴。
examples.en: The founding emperor was beloved by all the people.

examples.zh: 他治水有功，受到万民拥戴。
examples.en: His flood control earned him the love of the whole populace.

usage.en: Mostly historical writing.
usage.zh: 多用于历史叙述。

meaning.en: To act in accordance with the people's wishes.

equivalents: in tune with the popular will

examples.zh: 这项改革顺应民意，得到广泛支持。
examples.en: The reform follows the popular will and has wide support.

examples.zh: 政府应当顺应民意，解决群众关心的问题。
examples.en: The government should heed public opinion and solve people's concerns.

usage.en: Official language.
usage.zh: 官方用语。

natural: against the will of the people

meaning.en: To go against the people's wishes.

examples.zh: 违背民意的政策注定失败。
examples.en: Policies that defy the popular will are doomed.

examples.zh: 这个决定违背民意，引发了抗议。
examples.en: The decision went against public opinion and sparked protests.

usage.en: Formal; political commentary.
usage.zh: 书面，多用于政治评论。

meaning.en: To teach through entertainment.

examples.zh: 这款游戏寓教于乐，孩子们很喜欢。
examples.en: This game makes learning fun, and children love it.

examples.zh: 博物馆推出寓教于乐的亲子活动。
examples.en: The museum launched family activities that teach through play.

usage.en: Common in education and children's media.
usage.zh: 多用于教育、儿童节目。

meaning.en: To stimulate thought and reasoning.
meaning.zh: 引导人开动脑筋，开拓思路。

examples.zh: 好的问题能启发思维。
examples.en: Good questions get people thinking.

examples.zh: 老师用实验启发思维，引导学生自己找答案。
examples.en: The teacher uses experiments to stimulate thinking and lead students to find answers themselves.

usage.en: Education jargon.
usage.zh: 教育用语。

pinyin: sān tiān dǎ yú liǎng tiān shài wǎng
literal: three · days · catch · fish · two · days · dry · nets
natural: fish for three days, dry nets for two

meaning.en: Doing something by fits and starts, without perseverance.
meaning.zh: 比喻学习、工作时断时续，没有恒心。

examples.zh: 学英语不能三天打鱼两天晒网。
examples.en: You can't learn English by fits and starts.

examples.zh: 他健身总是三天打鱼，两天晒网，所以没效果。
examples.en: He exercises on and off, so it never works.

examples.zh: 三天打鱼两天晒网，怎么能学好钢琴？
examples.en: How can you learn piano if you only practise now and then?

story.en: Of Xue Pan's half-hearted schooling, the novel says he went to the clan school only 'three days fishing, two days drying nets' (三日打鱼，两日晒网).
story.zh: 《红楼梦》写薛蟠上学：“不过是三日打鱼，两日晒网。”

usage.en: Very common, especially to scold inconsistent students.
usage.zh: 极常用，多批评学习没恒心。

antonyms: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针

literal: Hua Tuo · again · in the world

meaning.en: A doctor of miraculous skill.
meaning.zh: 华佗又来到人间，称赞医生医术高明。

examples.zh: 您真是华佗再世，治好了我多年的老毛病。
examples.en: You're a miracle worker — you cured my chronic complaint.

examples.zh: 病人家属送来锦旗，上写“华佗再世”。
examples.en: The patient's family presented a banner reading 'Hua Tuo Reborn'.

usage.en: Praise for doctors, often on thank-you banners. Hua Tuo was the legendary Han physician.
usage.zh: 称赞医生，常写在锦旗上。华佗是东汉末年名医。
